name: Iconify Icons
description: Allows users to add icon sets into their projects, through the integration with Iconify API. This module provides a settings page to configure add the icon sets.
project_description:
The Iconify Icons module provides lightweight integration with the Iconify API, bringing a vast library of over 🤯 200,000 icons from more than 150 open-source icon packs directly to your Drupal site.

 

 Allows users to add high-quality, optimised SVG icons into their projects, ensuring a consistent and efficient workflow.

 Integrates Iconify Icons as an icon provider in Drupal 11.1.0 or higher (see #3490350 ) with integration enhanced by the UI Icons module.

 Try Iconify Icons 

 Installation 
 You can set up icons in two ways. We recommend using the ready-made recipe, but you can also install the modules manually if you prefer.

 
 Icons Toolkit Recipe (recommended) 
 Enable the Icons Toolkit recipe to automatically install all required modules and apply a fully preconfigured setup. No manual configuration is needed.

 See more details:

 Icons Toolkit (Recipe) 

 
 Alternative: Manual Installation 
 
 Install the UI Icons module and its required submodules: ui_icons , ui_icons_menu , and ui_icons_field . 
 Install the Iconify Icons module (version 2.0.x ). 
 When adding a new icon field or inserting an icon into a menu, select the desired icon set from the available Iconify collections.
